parts.label: Inner pouch lining
parts.description: Soft dark inner pouch forming the enclosed bag cavity behind the open metalwork exterior.

parts.label: Shoulder chain strap
parts.description: Single long doubled metal chain strap rising vertically from the gathered top of the bag.

parts.label: Linked metal body shell
parts.description: Gathered exterior shell assembled from interlinked dark metal discs and rings, including the reinforced top and lower perimeter.

parts.label: Turquoise cabochon embellishments
parts.description: Set of small turquoise-colored stone studs mounted across the exterior metal shell.
